section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the present study examining associations between women's body image and subjective happiness using data from the YouBeauty.com Body Image Survey (YBIS). Respondents from the West (primarily the United States) completed measures of weight-related body dissatisfaction and body appreciation. The study proposes a hypothesized model in which education and age shape BMI, which in turn affects body dissatisfaction and body appreciation, with these variables predicted to affect subjective happiness in opposite directions. This appears to be a single study with one sample.

Asset Caption.extract_value: Fig. 1 The hypothesised model, showing standardized path coefficients in the US sample. Body appreciation and body dissatisfaction were allowed to correlate (standardized coefficient = −.50, not shown). BA body appreciation, BD body dissatisfaction, SH subjective happiness. All coefficients were significant at p < .001
